call_site: After the established original_rooms furnishing loop, before the upstream block and final overview/map JSON export. Do not invoke inside the original_rooms loop.
registrations: The extension adds existing Serene household maps to maps/paths without changing their fixtures, and adds exactly inn_guest_floor to the existing town interior_scenes registry.

runtime_opt_ins.rearm_after_exit: Only the two authored stair doors use this rectangle. Arrival/load disarms; the player's own exit from the rectangle rearms. NPC presence cannot rearm it.
runtime_opt_ins.animation_driver: Only mill.drivetrain uses mill_wheel. Initial scene load and the existing opening-conclusion stop hook copy the existing mill_stopped value. No independent quest/save flag.
runtime_opt_ins.lantern_workshop_empty: Use upstream #250 LanternRest initialization and tests unchanged. PR4 only repairs full-width craft_table art and canonical phase aliases; collected contents retain the original zero-alpha surface while the real table remains visible.

legacy_save_behavior: Exact valid downstairs positions survive. Any old footprint intersecting a named new mill/stair/hearth blocker uses the existing checked room-spawn fallback; preserve the payload's party, quests, inventory and gold.
pre_furnish_guard: Inside original_rooms entity loop, before prev[e['id']]: if name=='mill' and e['id']=='mill.drivetrain':continue. This exact generated entity is replaced by the extension after legacy fixtures are rebuilt.
schedule_validation: After the extension has supplied all scene records, call validate_schedule(schedule, town, scene_records=maps). First generation must not depend on previous guest-floor or hearth map exports.
